tree.heading: General definition
tree.text: The term “taxable gifts” means the total amount of gifts made during the calendar year, less the deductions provided in subchapter C (section 2522 and following).

children.heading: In general
children.text: In the case of gifts (other than gifts of future interests in property) made to any person by the donor during the calendar year, the first $10,000 of such gifts to such person shall not, for purposes of subsection (a), be included in the total amount of gifts made during such year. Where there has been a transfer to any person of a present interest in property, the possibility that such interest may be diminished by the exercise of a power shall be disregarded in applying this subsection, if no part of such interest will at any time pass to any other person.

children.heading: Inflation adjustment
children.text: In the case of gifts made in a calendar year after 1998, the $10,000 amount contained in paragraph (1) shall be increased by an amount equal to— If any amount as adjusted under the preceding sentence is not a multiple of $1,000, such amount shall be rounded to the next lowest multiple of $1,000.
the cost-of-living adjustment determined under section 1(f)(3) for such calendar year by substituting “calendar year 1997” for “calendar year 2016” in subparagraph (A)(ii) thereof.

tree.heading: Transfer for the benefit of minor
tree.text: No part of a gift to an individual who has not attained the age of 21 years on the date of such transfer shall be considered a gift of a future interest in property for purposes of subsection (b) if the property and the income therefrom—

children.text: may be expended by, or for the benefit of, the donee before his attaining the age of 21 years, and
will to the extent not so expended—
pass to the donee on his attaining the age of 21 years, and
in the event the donee dies before attaining the age of 21 years, be payable to the estate of the donee or as he may appoint under a general power of appointment as defined in section 2514(c).

Exclusion for certain transfers for educational expenses or medical expenses

children.heading: In general
children.text: Any qualified transfer shall not be treated as a transfer of property by gift for purposes of this chapter.

children.heading: Qualified transfer
children.text: For purposes of this subsection, the term “qualified transfer” means any amount paid on behalf of an individual—
as tuition to an educational organization described in section 170(b)(1)(A)(ii) for the education or training of such individual, or
to any person who provides medical care (as defined in section 213(d)) with respect to such individual as payment for such medical care.

tree.heading: Waiver of certain pension rights
tree.text: If any individual waives, before the death of a participant, any survivor benefit, or right to such benefit, under section 401(a)(11) or 417, such waiver shall not be treated as a transfer of property by gift for purposes of this chapter.

tree.heading: Treatment of certain loans of artworks

children.heading: In general
children.text: For purposes of this subtitle, any loan of a qualified work of art shall not be treated as a transfer (and the value of such qualified work of art shall be determined as if such loan had not been made) if—
such loan is to an organization described in section 501(c)(3) and exempt from tax under section 501(c) (other than a private foundation), and
the use of such work by such organization is related to the purpose or function constituting the basis for its exemption under section 501.

children.heading: Qualified work of art
children.text: The term “qualified work of art” means any archaeological, historic, or creative tangible personal property.

children.heading: Private foundation
children.text: The term “private foundation” has the meaning given such term by section 509, except that such term shall not include any private operating foundation (as defined in section 4942(j)(3)).

notes.heading: Inflation Adjusted Items for Certain Years
notes.text: For inflation adjustment of certain items in this section, see Revenue Procedures listed in a table under section 1 of this title.
